builds.title: Reynolds’ Pipe, the figure
builds.summary: The same experiment as an isometric drawing, with a friction chart that jumps from 64/Re to Blasius the moment the dye breaks.

builds.title: Sénarmont’s Plate, the figure
builds.summary: Wax melts as an ellipse on a quartz crystal: Sénarmont’s 1847 sight of conductivity as a tensor.

builds.title: Transport Lab Upgrade
builds.summary: The course lab’s solver beside an exponential-scheme Crank–Nicolson upgrade, both checked against the exact solution.

builds.title: TEM Anatomy, the figure
builds.summary: A 200 kV transmission electron microscope cut in half: trace the electrons, switch bright field, dark field and diffraction, then explode the column.

builds.title: Sénarmont’s Plate
builds.summary: Sénarmont’s 1847 experiment as a pop-up book page. A hot stylus melts the wax on a quartz plate as an ellipse; turn the crystal and the ellipse turns with it.

builds.title: Reynolds’ Pipe
builds.summary: Reynolds’ 1883 experiment as a pop-up book page. Open the valve and watch the dye thread tear into turbulence.

builds.title: TEM Anatomy
builds.summary: A 200 kV transmission electron microscope you can take apart. Cut the column open, follow the beam through every lens, and switch the screen from image to diffraction.

builds.title: Durgapur Iron Zone
builds.summary: SAIL Durgapur's ironmaking as a poster whose figures stand up. Cut BF-3 open and watch its ten reactions light up where they run, ride a lump of sinter down to the hearth, and read the case study and the A0 poster right in the page.

builds.title: Lipase at the Interface
builds.summary: A real lipase built from its crystal structures. Watch its lid open on a drop of used cooking oil, step through the reaction that turns the oil into biodiesel atom by atom, and change pH, heat, metal ions and methanol to see what stops it.

builds.title: IITH Old Gym
builds.summary: The old gym at IIT Hyderabad, rebuilt in 3D from photos. Walk in at eye height, read it as a floor plan, and rearrange every machine with its spacing checked against published gym guidance. Switch layouts and watch the equipment glide to its new place.

builds.title: MicroVision AI
builds.summary: The motorized digital microscope our team of five built for MS2930, as a 16-slide deck with a live 3D model. Watch it light a sample, focus on Z, scan on X and name what it sees, then explode it into its parts.
